image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a stylized restaurant menu. The top features a red banner with illegible, gibberish text resembling a logo. Below are three illustrated food items (a sandwich/burger, a wrapped item, and a bowl of soup/salad) arranged horizontally. Beneath the illustrations is a dark section containing columns of white text that mimics menu descriptions and prices but is entirely nonsensical and unreadable. A vertical strip of illustrated food items runs down the center-left.
